# Anvesha Jewels

> Anvesha Jewels is a fine jewellery brand from Surat, Gujarat, India. Every piece is made to order in genuine gold (14K, 18K or 22K) with natural or lab-grown diamonds, chosen by the customer. Customers request a personal quote on WhatsApp.

- Website: https://www.anveshajewels.com
- WhatsApp / phone: +91 98986 18327
- Email: admin@anveshajewels.com
- Address: F-612 Surya Darshan Apartment, Citylight, Surat, Gujarat, India
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/anveshajewels?xtok=MWZjcnkwazFuOHE3OA==

## Jewellery
- [Rings](https://www.anveshajewels.com/rings): Solitaire silhouettes, luminous bands and considered details. Discover a ring that feels like a little part of you.
- [Necklaces](https://www.anveshajewels.com/necklaces): An intimate detail, a luminous finishing touch. Explore pendants and necklaces to wear close to your story.
- [Earrings](https://www.anveshajewels.com/earrings): From a quiet sparkle to a graceful drop, explore earrings that bring a little light to the way you move.
- [Bracelets](https://www.anveshajewels.com/bracelets): Delicate lines and graceful curves, made to follow your every gesture. Find your own expression in gold and diamonds.
- [Men's Jewellery](https://www.anveshajewels.com/mens-jewellery): Studs, bracelets, rings and chain & lockets, crafted in gold and diamonds for him.

## Buying
- Made to order; delivered in 10–15 days, insured shipping.
- Gold purity: 14K, 18K, 22K. Diamonds: natural or lab-grown, certified.
